# Similarweb

> Similarweb is a digital intelligence platform providing competitive analysis, market insights, and AI-powered research tools for web, app, and retail intelligence.

Similarweb offers comprehensive digital intelligence solutions including Web Intelligence, App Intelligence, Sales Intelligence, and AI Studio. The platform serves businesses seeking competitive analysis, market research, and data-driven insights through both self-service dashboards and API integrations.

## Key Topics

- Digital Intelligence
- Competitive Analysis
- Market Intelligence
- AI Studio
- Web Intelligence
- App Intelligence
- Sales Intelligence
- Retail Intelligence Suite
- AI-Powered Tools
- Web Traffic API
- Enterprise Solutions
- SEO Marketing
- Product Comparison
- Pricing & Packages

## Core Products & Solutions

- [AI Studio: AI-Powered Research & Insights](https://www.similarweb.com/corp/ai/ai-studio): AI Studio product featuring AI-powered research and intelligence dashboards for automated insights
- [Pricing & Packages - Choose Your Business Growth Plan](https://www.similarweb.com/packages/marketing): Similarweb pricing plans for Web, AI Search, App, and Shopper Intelligence solutions

## Developer Resources & API

- [Similarweb API Documentation](https://developers.similarweb.com): API documentation for Similarweb Web Traffic API and REST integration for developers

## Learning & Training

- [Similarweb Academy: Master Your Digital Intelligence](https://academy.similarweb.com): Training platform covering digital intelligence, SEO, competitor analysis, and analytics best practices
